policy: References informed taxonomy, adult size, shell proportions (apical angle, whorl count, fold count, carina, flat base, oblique aperture), soft-body layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, proportion or tracing source. The trade name Astrea covers several Lithopoma species, so the label is held at genus level.

referenceGradeRationale: Taxonomy, adult size and the classic shell description (whorl count, fold count, carina, flat base, oblique aperture) are authoritative; empty-shell photographs calibrate the shell profile. The extended soft body (foot outline, tentacle length, eye stalks) is inferred from general Turbinidae anatomy rather than calibrated live references, so the grade stays at B.
